notes:
Employee Cashbook → Ledger: Employee, Status and Reason are now dropdowns. The employee one has a search box that finds a person by name, code, designation or email, and the filter words follow the app language.

Employee Cashbook → Statement PDF: now opens on "All entries" with the bills attached, the same as the website, so a statement from the phone is the same document as one from the web.

Cashbook reports: a book's report lists what each entry cost, with the book's balance in red beside its name. A closed book shows the wallet balance as it stood when the book was closed, so its report reads the same every time.

Also: the in-app Help guide is updated.
